ai_summary: ## Executive Summary: Aarey Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd. Allotment  Aarey Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Ltd. has allotted 1,150,000 equity shares at Rs. 63.80 each, following the conversion of warrants, injecting approximately Rs. 5.50 crore (75% of issue price) into the company and increasing its issued and paid-up capital to 31,874,303 shares. This latest conversion contributes to an overall dilution of the existing share base, with 1,480,000 warrants still outstanding from the original preferential issue of 5,000,000 warrants, indicating potential further dilution. A key red flag is the significant inconsistencies and unclear presentation within the Annexure I tables regarding pre- and post-allotment holdings for specific investors, making precise tracking of ownership shifts challenging.
